_readme: Scheduled high-impact events for the event-risk filter (event-risk-filter.js). Fill in REAL dates as you learn them. The filter BLOCKS new premium selling within 1 day of a HIGH event and REDUCES to half size within 3 days; MEDIUM events only REDUCE within 3 days. Even with an empty list, the filter still blocks/reduces on live India VIX spikes and the news event-risk score. Types: RBI_MPC, UNION_BUDGET, ELECTION, FED_FOMC, CPI, GDP, EARNINGS, RESULTS. severity: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW.
